> Lightweight schema engine for TiddlyWiki — one tiddler per type, namespaced, hand-rolled UI

Define a type's fields, constraints, title formula, and namespace memberships all on a single tiddler. Spawn, edit, view, and validate typed instances through hand-rolled UIs with zero plugin dependencies.

## Key features

* **One tiddler per type** -- the type's full schema lives in fields and a JSON-encoded `kind.fields` array on a single tiddler. Body stays free for prose documentation.
* **Namespaces** -- types declare `kind.namespaces` (multi-membership). A namespace switcher restricts what's visible to the active scope.
* **Auto-computed titles** -- types declare a `kind.title-formula` filter; new instances get their title computed from sibling fields (e.g. `parent/abbrev`).
* **Live validation + bulk validator** -- inline errors as you edit; wiki-wide scan report on the validator tab.
* **Typeahead refs** -- filterable search input + filtered dropdown + selected pills with × remove; scales to large option sets.
* **Configurable stream-river view** -- each type chooses which fields appear in its in-river field bar; empty = bar hidden.
* **Instances Overview graph** -- the *Kind: Instances Overview* tiddler renders a whole-wiki graph of every instance, coloured per type, with toggleable per-ref-field edges and per-type show/hide; drag nodes to lay them out and positions persist. The hover tooltip offers per-node *edit* (live field editor in a modal), *delete* (confirm dialog; disabled with a hint while the node still has `parent`-field children) and *Add child* buttons for every kind whose `parent` field accepts the node's type -- the create form opens with the parent pre-filled and the same validation as the Creator. Needs a graph engine (see Prerequisites).
* **Context preview** -- a cascade-palette side-preview (shown for any instance) that draws just the instance's neighbourhood in the `parent` tree, reusing the Instances Overview layout/positions. Pills pick direction (*Descendants* / *Ancestors*), how many *levels* (1-5) to show, which *edges* to draw (multi-select), and which *types* to show (colour-coded chips -- click to hide); all four persist globally. Edges are colour- and stroke-coded per relationship and labelled when more than one is shown. Needs a graph engine plus the bimlas kin-filter plugin (see Prerequisites).
* **Hand-rolled UI** -- zero dependency on other rimir plugins (theme/components/typed). Optional soft dependency on doc-template for the branded documentation hub.

## Prerequisites

No external prerequisites for the core schema/UI. Optional: `rimir/doc-template` for the documentation hub; `flibbles/graph` plus a rendering engine (`flibbles/vis-network` or `rimir/cytoscape-engine`) for the *Instances Overview* graph (it shows an install hint if absent). The *Context* side-preview additionally needs `bimlas/kin-filter` (it walks the `parent` tree to a chosen depth).

## Quick start

1. Open the **type-builder** tab and define a new type (key, caption, icon, namespaces, title-formula, fields).
2. Open the **creator** tab, pick the type, fill the fields, click Create.
3. Open the resulting tiddler in the story river — the stream-view field bar appears at the top.
4. Use the **validator** tab for a wiki-wide constraint scan.

\procedure kind.cascade-save-instance(kind-tid, draft-tid, type-key, keep-open)
<%if [<keep-open>match[yes]] %>
<!-- Ctrl-Enter (mass-create): create the tiddler but KEEP the draft
     intact so the form stays populated for a quick follow-up entry.
     $action-createtiddler auto-uniquifies the basetitle on collision,
     so re-firing without changing fields yields "Name", "Name 1", …
     $savetitle captures the post-uniquification title; we then navigate
     to that — opens the new tiddler at the top of the story river
     behind the palette as visual confirmation. TW's tm-navigate doesn't
     focus the rendered tiddler frame, so the palette input keeps focus
     and the user can immediately Ctrl-Enter again for the next instance. -->
<$transclude $variable="kind.finalize-create" kind-tid=<<kind-tid>> kind-type-key=<<type-key>> draft-tid=<<draft-tid>> savetitle="$:/state/rimir/kind/__last-mass-create"/>
<$action-navigate $to={{$:/state/rimir/kind/__last-mass-create}}/>
<%else%>
<!-- Enter (single create): defensive apply-defaults (idempotent — fills
     only blank fields), create, clear the draft, navigate. Re-drilling
     "+ New <kind>" later re-seeds defaults via the drill's ca-actions. -->
<$transclude $variable="kind.apply-defaults-to" type-tid=<<kind-tid>> target-tid=<<draft-tid>>/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.finalize-create" kind-tid=<<kind-tid>> kind-type-key=<<type-key>> draft-tid=<<draft-tid>> savetitle="$:/state/rimir/kind/__last-saved-instance"/>
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<draft-tid>>/>
<$action-navigate $to={{$:/state/rimir/kind/__last-saved-instance}}/>

\procedure kind.cascade-create-here-init(host-tid, target-field, target-card, kind-tid)
<!-- Drill-open action for "Create here" rows: seeds the draft with defaults then
     pre-sets the back-ref so kind.eval-title sees the host's title in the Save row.
     The same seed runs again at save time as a safety net (idempotent). -->

<$action-listops $tiddler=<<draft-tid>> $field=<<target-field>> $subfilter="+[append<host-tid>]"/>
<%else%>
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<draft-tid>> $field=<<target-field>> $value=<<host-tid>>/>
<%endif%>
</$let>
</$let>
\end

\procedure kind.cascade-create-here(host-tid, target-field, target-card, kind-tid)
<!-- Save action for "Create here" Save row: re-runs the drill-open init (seed
     defaults + pre-set back-ref on draft — idempotent), then materialises the
     new instance via kind.finalize-create and deletes the draft. The back-ref
     ends up on the new tiddler because $action-createtiddler copies from the
     pre-seeded draft template. kind.eval-title sees the back-ref on the draft,
     matching the row-name preview the init produced. -->
<$let kind-type-key={{{ [<kind-tid>get[kind.type]] }}}>
<$let draft-tid={{{ [function[kind.create-here-draft-tid],<host-tid>,<target-field>,<kind-type-key>] }}}>
<$transclude $variable="kind.cascade-create-here-init" host-tid=<<host-tid>> target-field=<<target-field>> target-card=<<target-card>> kind-tid=<<kind-tid>>/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.finalize-create" kind-tid=<<kind-tid>> kind-type-key=<<kind-type-key>> draft-tid=<<draft-tid>> savetitle="$:/state/rimir/kind/__create-here-result"/>
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<draft-tid>>/>
</$let>
</$let>
\end

|!Version |!Date |!Changes |
|v0.1.66 |2026-06-04 |Kind icon lens now declares `ca-lens-actions: via-entity-type` — it owns the kind ''Open / Edit / Delete'' actions through cascade-palette's new lens-action bridge, so those actions stay available on every kind row even when the ''Icon'' lens slot is turned off (the actions are always-on, gated only by `ca-lens-when`, never by slot selection). Behaviour-preserving for users; declarative for the new contract. Needs cascade-palette ≥0.0.111. |
|v0.1.65 |2026-06-04 |Cascade-palette "Kind icons" migrated from the removed structure-toggle to a ''Kind'' icon ''lens'' (`$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/lens`, slot `icon`, gated by `ca-lens-when` on kind types existing). Selectable in the palette's ''Icon'' slot strip; same behaviour (each kind instance shows its `kind.icon`, off by default, persists across reloads). Needs cascade-palette ≥0.0.110. |
|v0.1.64 |2026-06-04 |Graph tooltip node actions + modal: hover tooltip on every kind-graph node (Instances Overview + Context preview) gains ''edit'' (live field editor in a modal), ''delete'' (confirm dialog; disabled with a hint while the node has `parent`-field children — guard re-checked in the modal) and ''Add child'' buttons for every kind whose `parent` ref field accepts the node's type (plus `kind.parent-kinds` children, `kg.child-kinds`). Create reuses the standard editor + `kind.finalize-create` with parent pre-filled and defaults applied. New `$:/plugins/rimir/kind/graph-modal` overlay (`$:/tags/AboveStory`, layered above the cascade-palette); tooltip buttons dismiss the graph popup on click. |
|v0.1.63 |2026-06-03 |Cascade-palette "Kind icons" structure toggle — when on, every menu row backed by a kind instance shows its type's `kind.icon` glyph at the front (all views, persists across reloads). Off by default; appears only while a kind type exists. Needs cascade-palette ≥0.0.109. |
|v0.1.62 |2026-06-02 |Refactor: `kind.kv` JSON-pair helper + `kind.finalize-create` save-flow consolidation. |
|v0.1.61 |2026-06-02 |Context preview: graph fills the side-preview pane's visible height (no scrolling). |
|v0.1.60 |2026-06-02 |Perf: graph edge colour/stroke computed per-field once, not per-edge. |
|v0.1.59 |2026-06-02 |Context preview: edge + type pills, colour-coded edges; graph + stylesheet fixes. |
|v0.1.58 |2026-06-02 |New: //Context// cascade-palette side-preview + shared graph module. |
|v0.1.57 |2026-06-02 |New: //Kind: Instances Overview// graph view. |
|v0.1.56 |2026-06-01 |Fix: dependent-default cascade didn't re-fire on ref/enum pick in either creator OR cascade-palette. |
|v0.1.55 |2026-05-31 |Unified `default` as a subfilter — dynamic defaults that read from the draft, re-fire after ref/enum changes. |
|v0.1.54 |2026-05-31 |Cascade-palette: structured CRUD drill for `kind.auto-children` — no more JSON typing. |
|v0.1.53 |2026-05-31 |Surface child kinds on the parent's editing UI + type-safe parent-kinds picker in CP + auto-create child instances on parent save. |
|v0.1.52 |2026-05-31 |Add child kinds + cascade-palette //Create here…// action. |
|v0.1.51 |2026-05-29 |Fix: ref field with no `ref-types` now lists all kind-instances instead of every tiddler in the wiki. |
|v0.1.50 |2026-05-28 |Bridge to cascade-palette ≥ 0.0.79: catalogue actions surface in every view automatically. |
|v0.1.49 |2026-05-28 |Migrate instance-view preview to cascade-palette's new tag-based side-preview protocol. |
|v0.1.48 |2026-05-28 |Move kind-instance view from Ctrl-hold detail drawer into the side-preview pane + live preview for create/edit + card-style redesign. |
|v0.1.47 |2026-05-28 |Four create-flow UX fixes — Reset row, Ctrl-Enter mass-create, draft re-seeding, DEL-to-unset field. |
|v0.1.46 |2026-05-27 |Perf: unique-constraint walks no longer scan every tiddler in the wiki on every render. |
|v0.1.45 |2026-05-27 |Fix: constraint violations no longer let users save invalid entities. |
|v0.1.44 |2026-05-27 |Big round: per-field `default` property with token expansion, multi-cardinality text fields, several latent bugs fixed. |
|v0.1.43 |2026-05-27 |Fix: delete-kind dialog always said //no instances exist// — instance count was broken since 0.1.39. |
|v0.1.42 |2026-05-27 |Fix: Save and Warning rows showed icon twice (💾💾 / ⛔⛔). |
|v0.1.41 |2026-05-27 |Save row previews computed title in its ca-name: `💾 Save as "<title>"`. |
|v0.1.40 |2026-05-27 |Disable Save when title-formula yields empty — show diagnostic warning row instead. |
|v0.1.39 |2026-05-27 |DEL-key delete on kind rows in Manage kinds + diagnostic consequence text. |
|v0.1.38 |2026-05-27 |Clone-kind flow: collapsed three stages → two; post-commit jumps back to Manage kinds. |
|v0.1.37 |2026-05-27 |After confirmed delete-kind, re-open the palette at Manage kinds instead of closing. |
|v0.1.36 |2026-05-27 |Layer B: clone an existing kind to seed a new kind (Manage kinds → //+ Clone existing kind…//). |
|v0.1.35 |2026-05-27 |Delete-kind confirm dialog now shows live instance count. |
|v0.1.34 |2026-05-27 |Clone-from-existing in cascade creator flows (Layer A of the templating idea). |
|v0.1.33 |2026-05-27 |In-cascade //+ Create new <type>// rows in ref-field pickers — nested spawn flow with breadcrumb via the cascade stage stack. |
|v0.1.32 |2026-05-26 |Rename a field's key in the cascade. |
|v0.1.31 |2026-05-26 |Reorder kind fields via Ctrl-↑ / Ctrl-↓ in the cascade. |
|v0.1.30 |2026-05-26 |Live create-form preview while editing a kind in the cascade. |
|v0.1.29 |2026-05-26 |`k` leader: drill straight into Manage kinds. |
|v0.1.28 |2026-05-26 |Cross-link from instance → kind schema editor. |
|v0.1.27 |2026-05-26 |Fix: `:map[X]` silently drops every result past index 0; cross-kind option pool returned ~1 value instead of N. |
|v0.1.26 |2026-05-25 |Fix: enum options picker now also includes library common-field options + filters blanks. |
|v0.1.25 |2026-05-25 |Cross-kind option pool for enum picker. |
|v0.1.24 |2026-05-25 |Multi-pick sub-stage for enum options + shared array-append helper. |
|v0.1.23 |2026-05-25 |Fix: min/max constraint write was still buggy in 0.1.22 — subtract-of-existing didn't fire, validity filter let everything through. |
|v0.1.22 |2026-05-25 |Fix: setting min/max constraint via cascade prefixed all existing constraints, not just the new one. |
|v0.1.21 |2026-05-25 |Three new field-types with intrinsic format validation: `url` / `email` / `phone`. |
|v0.1.20 |2026-05-25 |Fix: nested JSON-array reads silently returned empty. |
|v0.1.19 |2026-05-25 |Parameterised constraints (`min:N` / `max:N` / custom) in the constraints picker. |
|v0.1.18 |2026-05-25 |Add / delete field syncs `kind.stream-fields`. |
|v0.1.17 |2026-05-25 |Validation hints on field rows. |
|v0.1.16 |2026-05-25 |//+ Add new field// defaults typed=text. |
|v0.1.15 |2026-05-25 |//+ Create new kind…// row in Manage-kinds. |
|v0.1.14 |2026-05-25 |Fix: //+ Add new field// was writing to a phantom tiddler. |
|v0.1.13 |2026-05-25 |DEL on a field row removes that field (uses cascade-palette 0.0.50's new `ca-on-delete`). |
|v0.1.12 |2026-05-25 |//+ Add new field// row in Manage-kinds. |
|v0.1.11 |2026-05-25 |Constraints / options / ref-types editing in the per-field stage. |
|v0.1.10 |2026-05-25 |//+ Add field from library//: common-fields picker in Manage-kinds. |
|v0.1.9 |2026-05-25 |Typed + cardinality as drill-pickers. |
|v0.1.8 |2026-05-25 |Per-field property editing. |
|v0.1.7 |2026-05-25 |Fix: Manage-kinds metadata rows showed //(unset)// everywhere + added per-kind field-list rows. |
|v0.1.6 |2026-05-25 |Fix: Manage-kinds entry showed nothing. |
|v0.1.5 |2026-05-25 |Cascade-palette: Manage kinds (edit existing type-defs). |
|v0.1.4 |2026-05-21 |Cascade-palette scope tiddler — `,<kind>` prefix restricts results to instances of that kind. |
|v0.1.3 |2026-05-21 |All three root entries carry `ca-group: Kind Actions` for shared header clustering. |
|v0.1.2 |2026-05-21 |Cascade integration — drill-fixing pass. |
|v0.1.1 |2026-05-21 |Cascade-palette integration: three root entries (//Find entity//, //Find by kind//, //Create entity//) + three universal actions (//Open//, //Edit fields//, //Delete//). |
|v0.1.0 |2026-05-20 |Initial release. One-tiddler-per-type schema with namespacing; hand-rolled editor/creator/view/stream-view/validator/type-builder; field types text/longtext/number/date/datetime/enum/ref + $title/$calculated; constraints required/min/max/unique/unique:wiki. |

\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine

! Create instance

<$let
  active-ns={{{ [function[kind.active-ns]] }}}
  state-type="$:/state/rimir/kind/creator/selected-type"
>

<div class="kind-ns-row">
<strong>Namespace:</strong> <code><$text text={{{ [<active-ns>!is[blank]] ~[[(all)]] }}}/></code>
<span style="opacity:0.6;font-size:0.85em;">(change in [[settings|$:/plugins/rimir/kind/settings]])</span>
</div>

<div class="kind-ns-row">
<strong>Type:</strong>
<span class="kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[function[kind.top-level-types]] :filter[function[kind.belongs-to-ns],<active-ns>] +[sort[kind.type]]" variable="t">
<$button class={{{ [<state-type>get[text]match<t>then[kind-pill kind-pill-on]] ~[[kind-pill]] }}}>
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<state-type>> text=<<t>>/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.apply-defaults-to" type-tid=<<t>> target-tid={{{ [<t>get[kind.type]addprefix[$:/state/rimir/kind/draft/]] }}}/>
<$text text={{{ [<t>get[kind.icon]] }}}/>
 <$text text={{{ [<t>get[kind.caption]!is[blank]] ~[<t>get[kind.type]] }}}/>
</$button>
</$list>
</span>
</div>

<$list filter="[function[kind.types-all]] :filter[function[kind.belongs-to-ns],<active-ns>] :filter[function[kind.is-child-kind],<currentTiddler>!is[blank]] +[first[]]" variable="_">
<div class="kind-ns-row" style="opacity:0.55;">
<strong>Child kinds:</strong>
<span class="kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[function[kind.types-all]] :filter[function[kind.belongs-to-ns],<active-ns>] :filter[function[kind.is-child-kind],<currentTiddler>!is[blank]] +[sort[kind.type]]" variable="t">
<span class="kind-pill" style="cursor:not-allowed;" title={{{ [<t>get[kind.parent-kinds]addprefix[Create from within a parent of type: ]addsuffix[. Open a parent instance and use cascade-palette → Create here….]] }}}>
<$text text={{{ [<t>get[kind.icon]] }}}/>
 <$text text={{{ [<t>get[kind.caption]!is[blank]] ~[<t>get[kind.type]] }}}/>
</span>
</$list>
</span>
<span style="font-size:0.85em;">— only creatable from within a parent instance via the cascade-palette "Create here…" action.</span>
</div>
</$list>

<$let type-tid={{{ [<state-type>get[text]] }}}>
<%if [<type-tid>!is[blank]] %>
<$let
  type-key={{{ [<type-tid>get[kind.type]] }}}
  target-tid={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/draft/]addsuffix<type-key>] }}}
>

<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/kind/editor"/>

<p>
<$button disabled={{{ [function[kind.any-invalid],<type-tid>,<type-key>,<target-tid>!is[blank]then[yes]] }}}>
<$transclude $variable="kind.finalize-create" kind-tid=<<type-tid>> kind-type-key=<<type-key>> draft-tid=<<target-tid>> savetitle="$:/state/rimir/kind/__last-saved-instance"/>
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<target-tid>>/>
Create
</$button>
 
<$button tooltip="Discard the draft and re-seed it with the kind's field defaults — fresh entry starts pre-filled.">
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<target-tid>>/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.force-apply-defaults" type-tid=<<type-tid>> target-tid=<<target-tid>>/>
♻ Reset to defaults
</$button>
 
<span style="opacity:0.6;font-size:0.85em;">computed title: <code><$text text={{{ [function[kind.eval-title],<type-tid>,<target-tid>] }}}/></code></span>
</p>

</$let>
<%endif%>
</$let>

</$let>

<$fill $name="body">

!! Schema model

|!Element |!Stored as |!Discovery |
|Type |One tiddler with fields `kind.type`, `kind.caption`, `kind.icon`, `kind.namespaces`, `kind.title-formula`, `kind.stream-fields`, `kind.fields` (JSON) |`[has[kind.type]has[kind.fields]]` |
|Field def |Entry inside the type's `kind.fields` JSON array |`[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonindexes[]]` |
|Instance |Any tiddler with `kind.type: <type-key>` |`[kind.type<type-key>]` |

There are no separate per-field tiddlers, no inheritance slots, no enum tiddlers. The type tiddler is the single source of truth for its schema.

!! Namespace mechanism

* Each type's `kind.namespaces` field is a space-separated list of namespace tokens — a type can belong to many at once.
* The active namespace lives in `$:/config/rimir/kind/active-namespace` (single value; empty = all).
* All UI surfaces that enumerate types — //creator//, //overview//, //validator// — filter via the `kind.belongs-to-ns` function in `engine.tid`.

!! Field types (`typed` values)

|!`typed` |!Editor |!Storage |
|`text` |single-line `<$edit-text>` |plain string |
|`longtext` |textarea |plain string |
|`number` |numeric input |plain string |
|`date` |`<$edit-date>` |TW date format |
|`datetime` |`<$edit-date>` with time |TW datetime format |
|`url` |single-line `<$edit-text type="url">` |plain string; live format check requires `http://` or `https://` prefix |
|`email` |single-line `<$edit-text type="email">` |plain string; live format check `local@domain.tld` |
|`phone` |single-line `<$edit-text type="tel">` |plain string; live format check for German numbers (`+49` or `0` prefix) |
|`enum` |single: `<$select>`; multi: pill toggle row |single string or list-field |
|`ref` |typeahead (filter input + dropdown + selected pills with ×) |single tiddler title or list-field |
|`$title` |read-only |computed from `kind.title-formula` |
|`$calculated` |read-only |computed from the field's `formula` |

Extension point: `field-input.tid` is one `<%if [<typed>match[X]]%>` cascade. Adding a field type = one new branch.

!! Constraints

|!Constraint |!Meaning |
|`required` |Must have a value (blocking) |
|`min:N` |Min N characters (text/longtext/url/email/phone) or N entries (multi-enum / multi-ref) |
|`max:N` |Max N characters or entries |
|`unique` |Unique among instances of the same type |
|`unique:wiki` |Unique wiki-wide (across all tiddlers) |
|''(intrinsic)'' |`url` / `email` / `phone` fields carry a built-in format check that fires when the value is non-blank. See `kind.viol-format-url` / `-email` / `-phone` in `engine.tid`. Regex patterns live in `_patterns.tid`. |

The validator reports any violation as a row in its bulk report. The editor shows live error messages below each input.

Save gating: the in-tiddler creator's Create button is disabled when `kind.any-invalid` returns non-empty (the disabled expression appends `then[yes]` because TW's `$button` widget only treats the literal string `"yes"` as truthy). The cascade-palette flows (`+ New <kind>` and spawn `+ Create new <ref-kind>`) emit a Warning row in place of the Save leaf when `any-invalid` fires — same dispatch pattern as the title-empty Warning row. Warning rows carry `"ca-after-fire":"keep"` so Enter is a no-op (the palette stays open and the user can keep editing).

!! Title generation

When `kind.title-formula` is set, the creator computes a new instance's title by evaluating the formula against the draft state tiddler:

```
\function kind.eval-title(type-tid, target-tid)
  [<type-tid>get[kind.title-formula]]
  :map[<target-tid>subfilter<currentTiddler>]
```

Example formula: `[get[parent]][[/]][get[abbrev]]+[join[]]` produces `parent-title/abbrev` style titles.

!! Stream-view (ViewTemplate auto-registration)

`viewtemplate.tid` is tagged `$:/tags/ViewTemplate` with `list-after: $:/core/ui/ViewTemplate/title`. On any tiddler with a `kind.type` field, it renders `stream-view.tid`, which reads `kind.stream-fields` from the type and emits a compact bar. Empty/missing `kind.stream-fields` = bar renders nothing (self-disabling).

A click on a field cell opens a popup containing the field's editor; a top-bar toggle switches to inline-edit mode (the editor replaces the cell directly).

!! Shared infrastructure

* ''engine.tid'' — all shared functions: type discovery, namespace filtering, JSON field-array accessors, constraint extraction, validation predicates, display helpers (truncation, ref resolution), title-formula evaluation
* ''field-input.tid'' — typed-dispatch input widget used by editor, stream-view popup, stream-view inline, and type-builder live preview
* ''editor.tid'' — 2-column table editor; takes only `target-tid` in scope; transcludes field-input per row

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! Plugin files

|!File |!Role |
|`engine.tid` |Shared functions (type discovery, JSON access, validation predicates, helpers) |
|`field-input.tid` |Per-field input dispatch (text/longtext/number/date/datetime/enum/ref/computed) |
|`editor.tid` |2-column form for editing one instance |
|`view.tid` |Read-only single-instance table view |
|`stream-view.tid` |Field bar for the stream river; popup/inline edit toggle |
|`viewtemplate.tid` |ViewTemplate hook that auto-renders stream-view on every `kind.type` instance |
|`creator.tid` |Type picker + editor + Create button (computes title) |
|`validator.tid` |Bulk wiki-wide constraint report |
|`overview.tid` |Card grid of types in the active namespace |
|`type-builder.tid` |Structured editor for type metadata + JSON textarea for fields |
|`settings.tid` |Namespace switcher + stream-bar truncation preference |
|`styles.tid` |All CSS, no rr-* dependency |

!! Restart rules

|!Change |!Restart needed? |
|Edit any `.tid` (engine, editor, creator, …) |No — filesystem-watcher syncs |
|Add a new type via type-builder |No — discovery is automatic |
|Add a new field type (extend `field-input.tid`) |No |
|Add a new constraint (extend `engine.tid` validation predicates) |No |

There are no JS modules in `v0.1.0`, so no restarts are required for any plugin edit.

!! Defining a new type

# Open the //type-builder// tab (`$:/plugins/rimir/kind/type-builder`).
# Use the ''Create blank type'' button, supplying a new title (e.g. `$:/myns/types/task`).
# Fill the metadata section: `kind.type` (key), `kind.caption`, `kind.icon`, `kind.namespaces`, `kind.title-formula`, `kind.stream-fields`.
# Edit the JSON in the //Field definitions// section. The //Parsed preview// table updates as you type; the //Live editor preview// shows what an instance editor will look like.
# Open the //creator// tab and try creating an instance.

!! Adding a new field type

# Open `field-input.tid`.
# Find the dispatch cascade (`<%elseif [<field-typed>match[X]]%>` chain).
# Add a new branch for your new `typed` value.
# (Optional) Update the //typed// reference table in `doc/architecture.tid`.

!! Adding a new constraint

# Open `engine.tid`.
# Add a `kind.viol-<name>(type-tid, field-key, target-tid)` filter function that returns non-empty when the constraint is violated.
# Add a corresponding `<%if [function[kind.viol-<name>]]%>` branch in `field-input.tid` (for live errors) and `validator.tid` (for bulk report).
# Extend `kind.viol-any` so the creator's disabled-button predicate covers the new constraint.

!! Known limitations (v0.1.0)

* The type-builder's field-list editor is a textarea (raw JSON); a fully-structured row-by-row editor with add/delete/reorder is planned for v0.2.
* Multi-value uniqueness is exact-string-equality, not set-equality. Two instances with assignees `"alice bob"` and `"bob alice"` are NOT considered duplicates.
* No referential integrity: deleting a tiddler that other instances reference does not clean up the references.
* No schema migration: changing a field's `typed` after instances exist may leave stale values.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! A task type (orga namespace)

Create a type tiddler with the following fields:

```
title: $:/orga/types/task
kind.type: task
kind.namespaces: orga
kind.caption: Task
kind.icon: 🧮
kind.title-formula: [get[parent]][[/]][get[abbrev]]+[join[]]
kind.stream-fields: status assignee due-date
kind.fields: [{"key":"abbrev","caption":"Abbreviation","icon":"🔜","typed":"text","constraints":["required","min:3","unique"]},{"key":"description","caption":"Description","typed":"longtext"},{"key":"parent","caption":"Parent","icon":"📁","typed":"ref","ref-types":["project","workstream"],"cardinality":"single"},{"key":"status","caption":"Status","icon":"🚦","typed":"enum","options":["open","doing","done"],"cardinality":"single","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"assignee","caption":"Assignee","icon":"👤","typed":"ref","ref-types":["person"],"cardinality":"multi"},{"key":"due-date","caption":"Due","icon":"📅","typed":"date"}]
```

After saving, the //creator// tab shows ''Task'' in its type dropdown (when the active namespace is ''orga'' or blank). Filling fields and clicking Create produces a tiddler titled `<parent>/<abbrev>` with `kind.type: task` and the field values written through.

!! A shared "note" type (orga and private namespaces)

A type can belong to multiple namespaces:

```
title: $:/shared/types/note
kind.type: note
kind.namespaces: orga private
kind.caption: Note
kind.icon: 📝
kind.title-formula: [[note-]] [get[topic]] +[join[]]
kind.stream-fields: topic created
kind.fields: [{"key":"topic","caption":"Topic","typed":"text","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"body","caption":"Body","typed":"longtext"}]
```

Switching the active namespace between ''orga'' and ''private'' (in //settings//) — this type appears in both.

!! Format-validated fields (url / email / phone)

A `person` type with contact fields demonstrates the three format-validated typed values:

```
title: $:/orga/types/person
kind.type: person
kind.namespaces: orga
kind.caption: Person
kind.icon: 👤
kind.stream-fields: email phone homepage
kind.fields: [{"key":"name","typed":"text","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"email","caption":"Email","icon":"📧","typed":"email","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"phone","caption":"Phone","icon":"📞","typed":"phone"},{"key":"homepage","caption":"Homepage","icon":"🔗","typed":"url"}]
```

Each format-validated field surfaces a live error in the editor and a row in the bulk validator if its value doesn't fit the expected shape:

* ''url'' — must start with `http://` or `https://`
* ''email'' — must look like `local@domain.tld` (no spaces, no extra `@`)
* ''phone'' — German format: must start with `+49` or `0`, then at least six chars from digits/spaces/`-`/`/`/`(`/`)`

Empty values don't trigger the format error (use a `required` constraint if the field is mandatory). Character-length constraints work too: `min:8` on an email enforces an 8-character minimum.

You can also grab these as ready-made library entries via type-builder's ''Add field'' dropdown or cascade-mode's ''+ Add field from library…'' — the three common-fields `url` / `email` / `phone` ship with the plugin.

!! Multi-ref typeahead (large option sets)

For ref fields with many possible targets, the typeahead UI shows a filterable search input. Selected values render as pills with × removal. Example field def:

```json
{"key":"stakeholders","caption":"Stakeholders","icon":"👥","typed":"ref","ref-types":["person","team"],"cardinality":"multi"}
```

The candidate set is `[enlist[person team]] :map:flat[all[shadows+tiddlers]kind.type<currentTiddler>] +[unique[]]` — every instance of `person` or `team` in the wiki. The search input filters by title and caption.

!! Validator interpretation

Open the //validator// tab. Each type heading shows the instance count. A table follows with one row per violation:

* ''Red rows'' — blocking constraints (`required`, `min:N`, `max:N`, `unique`, `unique:wiki`, title mismatch)

If a type has no violations, the table is empty (just the heading + "//No instances//" if applicable).

!! Stream-view in action

Once a type's `kind.stream-fields` is set (e.g. `status assignee due-date`), every instance opened in the story river renders a compact field bar above the body:

```
🧮  🚦 doing  👤 Mirko  📅 23rd May 2026  ✎ popup
```

Clicking a cell pops up the field's editor. Clicking the ✎ toggle switches to inline-edit mode (the editor replaces the cell directly).

!! A child kind: jogging-round inside journal

Set `kind.parent-kinds: journal` on a kind to mark it as a ''child kind'' — only creatable from inside an existing instance of one of the listed parent kinds.

```
title: $:/private/types/journal
kind.type: journal
kind.namespaces: private
kind.caption: Journal
kind.icon: 📓
kind.title-formula: [<currentTiddler>get[date]]
kind.fields: [{"key":"date","caption":"Date","typed":"date","constraints":["required","unique"]}]
```

```
title: $:/private/types/jogging-round
kind.type: jogging-round
kind.parent-kinds: journal
kind.namespaces: private
kind.caption: Jogging round
kind.icon: 🏃
kind.title-formula: [<currentTiddler>get[parent]] [[/jog/]] [<currentTiddler>get[distance]] +[join[]]
kind.fields: [{"key":"distance","caption":"Distance (km)","typed":"number","constraints":["required"]},{"key":"buddies","caption":"Buddies","typed":"ref","ref-types":["person"],"cardinality":"multi"}]
```

In the cascade-palette //Create entity// drill, ''jogging-round'' is hidden — only ''journal'' is offered. To create a jogging-round, open an existing journal instance (e.g. via //Find entity// or //By parent//), press Space to open its action menu, and pick ''Create here…''. The drill emits one row per matching kind, grouped by attachment direction:

* ''Create child'' cluster — one row per kind whose `kind.parent-kinds` includes this instance's `kind.type`. Backref field is the standard `parent`. Here: ''+ Jogging round''.
* ''Create reference'' cluster — one row per (kind, field) pair where the kind has a ref-typed field whose `ref-types` includes this instance's `kind.type`. Disambiguation: the field's caption is appended in parens, so a `Task` with both `assignee` and `requester` ref'ing `person` shows as ''+ Task (as assignee)'' and ''+ Task (as requester)''.

Selecting a row opens the standard spawn-create form (Save row + Clone-from-existing + per-field edit rows). The back-reference field is pre-set on the draft BEFORE the title formula evaluates, so a formula like `[<currentTiddler>get[parent]] [[/jog/]] [<currentTiddler>get[distance]]` shows the host's title in the Save row preview as the user fills the other fields. Saving creates the new instance with the back-ref already wired — the validator's child-kind check (//parent's `kind.type` must be in this kind's `kind.parent-kinds`//) is satisfied by construction.

Validator behaviour for hand-edited or migrated data: any `jogging-round` instance without a `parent`, or whose `parent` doesn't have `kind.type: journal`, surfaces in the //Validator// tab as a ''parent-kinds mismatch'' row.

!! Auto-children: every conversation gets a streams-note

Set `kind.auto-children` on the parent kind to spawn child instances every time a parent instance is saved.

```
title: $:/private/types/conversation
kind.type: conversation
kind.caption: Conversation
kind.icon: 💬
kind.fields: [{"key":"date","typed":"date"},{"key":"topic","typed":"text","constraints":["required"]}]
kind.title-formula: [<currentTiddler>get[topic]]
kind.auto-children: [{"kind":"streams-note","fields":{"caption":"Conversation Minutes"}}]
```

```
title: $:/private/types/streams-note
kind.type: streams-note
kind.parent-kinds: conversation
kind.caption: Streams note
kind.icon: 📝
kind.fields: [{"key":"caption","typed":"text","constraints":["required"]}]
kind.title-formula: [<currentTiddler>get[parent]] [[/]] [<currentTiddler>get[caption]] +[join[]]
```

Saving a new `conversation` titled "Project kickoff" automatically materialises `Project kickoff/Conversation Minutes` as a `streams-note` instance with `parent: "Project kickoff"` and `caption: "Conversation Minutes"`. The streams-note's `kind.title-formula` evaluates against the seeded draft so it sees the back-ref. This works from every create path — in-tiddler //Creator// button, cascade-palette //+ New Conversation//, //+ Create new conversation// from a ref-field picker, and //Create here…// on any host that lists `conversation` as a child-kind or has a ref-back to it.

''Editing this from the cascade-palette'' (no JSON typing required): //Manage kinds// → ''Conversation'' → ''auto-children (1)'' drills into the auto-children list. The existing entry shows as ''Streams note — caption: Conversation Minutes''. Drilling in opens the entry — the ''caption'' override is a text-row you can re-edit; DEL removes it. ''+ Add field override…'' picks from the child kind's remaining fields (only fields not yet overridden are listed). Back at the auto-children list, ''+ Add auto-child entry…'' picks any kind from the wiki — DEL on an entry row removes the whole entry.

The same kind's `kind.parent-kinds: conversation` makes `streams-note` discoverable as a child kind (visible in the conversation's Type-builder and CP //Manage kinds// drill) AND offers a //+ Streams note// row in the conversation instance's //Create here…// action for additional notes beyond the auto-created one. Auto-created notes coexist with manually-added ones — both have the same `parent` field.

Multiple auto-children entries are supported — list as many as needed. To skip auto-creation, omit `kind.auto-children` or set to `[]`. Entries pointing at non-existent kinds are silently skipped.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! Q: Why a new plugin alongside `rimir/typed`?

`typed` (~1600 lines) grew several features that don't pay rent inside TiddlyWiki's bag-of-fields model:

* 3-level slot inheritance (`:0`/`:1`/`:2`) — needs `rrfunc` because native `function[]` leaks; needs `$importvariables` for the parent chain; capped at 3 levels by TW issue #9647
* Separate per-field tiddlers (e.g. ~40 in `orga-data-model`)
* Per-type field overrides via the `validity` field
* Cross-plugin enum tiddlers with their own inheritance
* Two object-ref editor modes (typeahead + pills)

`kind` keeps the spirit (schema-as-tiddlers, JSON-friendly, validator) and drops all of the above. The result is ~50% the code with explicit namespace support added.

!! Q: Why no inheritance?

In real schemas the inheritance was mostly used for one thing: a shared base (`_node`) defining common fields like `title`, `caption`, `description`, `parent`. With flat schemas you copy those 4-5 fields into every type tiddler. That's <50 lines of JSON duplication across a 10-type domain model — cheap, especially when the type-builder makes copy-paste easy. The override pattern (subtype dropping a base field via `:0`) was clever but rare and often a smell. And `[has[kind.type]]` already gives you an "all instances" filter without needing a base type.

!! Q: How do I share fields across types?

You don't, structurally. You copy the field def into each type's `kind.fields` JSON. That's the price of KISS. If you find yourself maintaining the same 10-field block across 8 types, you can extract a shared `kind.fields` value into a config tiddler and reference it — but for v0.1.0 that's manual.

!! Q: How do I migrate from `rimir/typed`?

Both plugins can coexist (different field namespaces: `rrt.*` vs `kind.*`, different instance markers). To migrate one type at a time:

# Read the typed type tiddler's `rrt.fields:0()`, `:1()`, `:2()` body
# Look up each field's def in the corresponding `*-data-model` plugin
# Compose a single `kind.fields` JSON array with the union
# Move `validity`-restricted overrides into the relevant subtype's JSON directly
# Update instance tiddlers from `rrt.type: X` to `kind.type: X` (one-line `$:/state/...` action filter)

After migrating all types, you can remove the typed plugin.

!! Q: What if I want a field type that's not in the list?

Add it. Open `field-input.tid`, find the `<%elseif [<field-typed>match[X]]%>` cascade, add a new branch. Whatever wikitext renders an editable widget. The constraint and validation logic in `engine.tid` already covers the generic cases (required/min/max/unique); add a `kind.viol-<name>` function if your new type needs new constraints.

!! Q: Why JSON for the field array instead of separate field tiddlers?

The JSON-in-one-field approach trades reusability for locality. The whole schema for one type is in one tiddler — open it, see everything. With separate field tiddlers you'd be reading two or three tiddlers in parallel to understand a type. For the volume most users hit (single-digit types per namespace, 5-15 fields per type), locality wins.

The `kind.fields` field stores stringified-JSON because storing as a `application/json` body would force the type tiddler to be saved as `.json + .json.meta` (two files), which breaks the convention of one-tiddler-per-file. The body stays free for prose documentation of the type.

!! Q: Why aren't multi-value uniqueness checks set-aware?

`unique` and `unique:wiki` use exact string equality on the whole field value. For multi-value refs/enums where order doesn't semantically matter (e.g. `assignee: "alice bob"` vs `assignee: "bob alice"`), this means a logical-duplicate isn't flagged. Fixing this properly would require value normalization (sort + dedupe before comparison) and a stronger uniqueness predicate. Planned for v0.2 if needed.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! What it does

''kind'' is a lightweight schema engine for TiddlyWiki. Each type's full definition — fields, constraints, title formula, icon, namespace memberships, and stream-river display config — lives on a single tiddler. Instances are plain tiddlers marked with a `kind.type` field. No inheritance, no separate per-field tiddlers, no central registry.

!! Features

* ''Schema-as-tiddler'' — one tiddler per type, with field defs as a JSON array in `kind.fields`
* ''Discovery'' — `[all[shadows+tiddlers]has[kind.type]has[kind.fields]]` finds all type tiddlers
* ''Namespaces'' — types declare `kind.namespaces`, the active scope picks one (or all)
* ''Editor'' — 2-column form (label + input), table-style, with live validation messages
* ''Field Bar'' — auto-rendered in the stream river on every instance; configurable per type; self-disabling
* ''Creator'' — pick a type, fill fields, click Create; title computed from `kind.title-formula`
* ''Validator'' — wiki-wide report of constraint violations
* ''Type-builder'' — structured editor for type metadata + JSON textarea for fields, with live preview
* ''Instances Overview'' (soft-dep on a graph engine) — the ''Kind: Instances Overview'' tiddler renders a whole-wiki graph of every instance. Nodes are coloured per type (palette by sorted type index, or an optional per-type `kind.color` override), seeded onto a stable grid so the layout never reshuffles; dragging a node persists its position to `$:/config/rimir/kind/instances-overview/structure`. A search box filters nodes by caption/title, an ''Edges'' checkbox row toggles which ref-typed fields are drawn as edges (default `parent`), and a colour-coded ''Types'' row shows/hides instances per type (default all shown). Edges are colour- and stroke-coded per ref-field (`kg.edge-color` / `kg.edge-stroke`) and labelled with the field name when more than one field is drawn. The hover tooltip carries per-node actions: ''edit'' opens a modal with the standard live field editor, ''delete'' opens a confirm dialog (disabled with a hint while the node still has `parent`-field children — the modal re-checks the guard at render time), and ''Add child'' buttons appear for every kind whose `parent` ref field accepts the node's type (plus explicit `kind.parent-kinds` children, via `kg.child-kinds`) — the create form pre-fills `parent`, applies field defaults, and reuses `kind.finalize-create`, so title-formula/validation/auto-children behave exactly like the Creator. All three buttons dismiss the tooltip on click and hand over to the `$:/plugins/rimir/kind/graph-modal` overlay (tagged `$:/tags/AboveStory`; layered above the cascade-palette so it also works from the Context side-preview). Needs `flibbles/graph` + a rendering engine; shows an install hint when absent.
* ''Context preview'' (soft-dep on a graph engine + bimlas kin-filter) — a cascade-palette side-preview shown for any kind-instance that draws just that instance's neighbourhood in the `parent` tree, reusing the //Instances Overview// renderer and persisted positions. ''Direction'' pills choose `↓ Descendants` (default) or `↑ Ancestors`, ''Levels'' pills choose how many hops (1–5, default 2), ''Edges'' pills multi-select which ref-fields to draw, and colour-coded ''Types'' pills toggle which kind-types are shown — every setting persists globally under `$:/state/rimir/kind/context/`, and the edge pills carry each relationship's own colour so the row doubles as a legend. The subgraph is selected with `[kin:parent:<dir>:<depth>[<base>]]`. The graph wiring is shared with the overview via the `$:/plugins/rimir/kind/graph` module (the `kg-graph` renderer + `kg.*` functions, incl. `kg.edge-color`/`kg.edge-stroke`), so both views stay in sync.
* ''Child kinds'' — set `kind.parent-kinds` to a list of parent type-keys to mark a kind as only creatable from within a parent instance. Hidden from global create surfaces (Creator tab, cascade //Create entity// drill); creatable via the per-instance ''Create here…'' cascade-palette action which also surfaces a ''Create reference'' cluster for any kind that has a ref-typed field pointing back to the host's kind. Type-builder and the cascade //Manage kinds// drill both surface the child kinds of each type (drillable in CP) so the parent-↔-child relationship is visible from either side.
* ''Auto-children'' — set `kind.auto-children` on a parent kind (JSON array of `{kind, fields}` entries) to auto-create child instances every time a parent instance is saved. The child's `parent` field is pre-set to the new parent's title before the child's `kind.title-formula` evaluates, so the child's title can reference the parent. Useful for "every conversation gets a //Conversation Minutes// streams-note" patterns.
* ''Cascade-palette integration'' (soft-dep) — when `rimir/cascade-palette` is installed, kind contributes ''Find by kind'', ''Find entity'', ''Create entity'', and ''Manage kinds'' root entries to the palette. The leader key ''`k`'' jumps straight into the ''Manage kinds'' drill. ''Manage kinds'' is the cascade-mode equivalent of the Type-builder tab: ''+ Create new kind…'' at the root captures a type-key and creates a stub tiddler with the type-builder's defaults; ''+ Clone existing kind…'' picks a source kind, then a text-input row captures the new type-key and clones the schema (`kind.fields` / `kind.title-formula` / `kind.stream-fields` / `kind.namespaces` copied; `kind.type` / `kind.caption` / `kind.icon` blank for the user to set). Drill into an existing kind to edit metadata (caption / icon / namespaces / title-formula / stream-fields), drill into one of its fields to rename the field key (with `kind.stream-fields` auto-sync; instance values stay under the old key) / set typed / caption / icon / cardinality / constraints (toggles for required / unique / unique:wiki; text-edit rows for min:N / max:N; +Add custom constraint…) / options / ref-types via picker sub-stages, ''+ Add field from library…'' picks from common-field defs, ''+ Add new field…'' captures a new field key and creates a row with `typed: text` so it is immediately editable (drill in to change typed / caption / constraints), DEL on a field row removes it with a confirm step, ''DEL on a kind row'' (Manage kinds top-level) removes the kind with a confirm step whose consequence text spells out how many instances would be orphaned (same as the in-drill `🗑 Delete this kind` leaf), ''Ctrl-↑ / Ctrl-↓'' reorder the focused field within `kind.fields` (the array order IS the form field order, so the move propagates to instances created after). Adding a field (either path) auto-appends the key to `kind.stream-fields` (idempotent); deleting a field also removes its key from that list. ''Live create-form preview'' — while drilled into a kind's schema, the palette splits 50/50 and the right pane renders the create-instance form (the same one ''Create entity'' shows) against a per-kind preview-draft tiddler; the form re-renders as the user edits the schema so the effect of every field change is immediately visible. ''Create entity'' opens a draft form with one row per editable field, an optional ''📋 Clone fields from existing <kind>'' drill that picks a source instance and copies its field values into the draft (computed fields and `kind.fields[].clone: skip` excluded), and a ''Save'' leaf whose name previews the computed title (e.g. `💾 Save as "test"`) or swaps to a ''⛔ Cannot save — title-formula yields empty'' row if the formula resolves to empty — the row swaps live as fields fill. ''Ref-field pickers'' also offer ''+ Create new <X>'' (drills into a nested spawn-create flow with its own Save / Clone / field-edit + Cancel via Esc; on Save the new instance is materialised AND linked into the parent's ref field; pops back to the picker with the new ref selected, supports arbitrary nesting depth via the same cascade stack) alongside the existing candidate list. Find by kind / Find entity drill kind → instance lists, with a ''live instance preview'' in the side-preview pane — auto-attached via the cascade-palette tag ''`$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/side-preview`'' on `palette/preview/instance-view`. The preview's `ca-preview-applies` filter (`[<currentTiddler>has[kind.type]]`) matches any kind-instance row, so ↑/↓ across results updates the read-only card view live. The same preview also auto-attaches during ''+ New <Kind>'' (anchored to the draft tiddler — every field commit on the left re-renders the card on the right) and during the ''Edit fields'' action (anchored to the entity being modified). ''Kind lens'' — kind also ships a ''lens'' (tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/lens`) that appears as the ''Kind'' option in the palette's ''Icon'' slot chooser whenever any kind type is defined. Selected (←→ / ↵ on the ''Kind'' pill in the Icon strip), every menu row backed by a kind instance shows its type's `kind.icon` glyph at the front of the row, across all views; the choice persists across reloads. Off by default. (The lens model — a per-slot single-select decorator that projects a row's name / icon / annotation — supersedes the former cascade-palette ''structure toggle''.)

!! Schema model

* ''Type tiddlers'' — fields `kind.type` (the key), `kind.caption`, `kind.icon`, `kind.namespaces`, `kind.title-formula`, `kind.stream-fields`, and `kind.fields` (JSON array)
* ''Field defs'' — entries inside the JSON array with `key`, `typed`, `caption`, `icon`, `constraints`, `options` (enum), `ref-types` + `cardinality` (ref)
* ''Instance tiddlers'' — any tiddler with `kind.type: <type-key>` is an instance

!! Prerequisites

TiddlyWiki ≥ 5.4.0 in Node.js server mode. No other plugin dependencies. Optional: `$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template` for the documentation hub you're reading right now.

!! Quick start

# Open the ''type-builder'' tab; create a blank type and fill its metadata
# Paste a field-list JSON (see the Examples section)
# Open the ''creator'' tab, pick the type, fill the fields, click Create
# Open the resulting tiddler in the story river — the field bar appears at the top
# Use the ''validator'' tab to scan the whole wiki for constraint violations

<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/callout" type="info">
<$fill $name="body">''Why a new plugin alongside `rimir/typed`?'' typed has accumulated features (3-level inheritance, separate per-field tiddlers, two ref-editor modes, ~1600 lines). kind drops everything that doesn't pay rent in TiddlyWiki's bag-of-fields model and adds namespaces. See the FAQ for details.</$fill>
</$transclude>

</$fill>
</$transclude>
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/reference":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind/doc/reference","rdt.order":"6","rdt.plugin-key":"kind","rdt.plugin-name":"kind","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Lightweight schema engine — one tiddler per type, namespaced","rdt.section":"Reference","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! Type tiddler fields

|!Field |!Required |!Description |
|`kind.type` |Yes |Unique type key. Instances of this type carry `kind.type: <this-value>`. |
|`kind.fields` |Yes |Stringified-JSON array of field definitions. See //Field def schema// below. |
|`kind.caption` |No |Display name shown in dropdowns, validator headings, etc. |
|`kind.icon` |No |Emoji or short text shown alongside the caption |
|`kind.namespaces` |No |Space-separated namespace memberships. Empty = visible only when active namespace is //(all)//. |
|`kind.parent-kinds` |No |Space-separated list of parent type-keys. Non-empty → ''child kind'' — hidden from global creation surfaces (in-tiddler creator's primary pill row, cascade-palette //Create entity// drill). Only creatable via the per-instance cascade-palette ''Create here…'' action on an existing instance of a kind in this list. Instance back-reference uses the standard `parent` field. Multi-valued for shared children (e.g. `journal training-log`). Validator flags instances whose `parent` is missing OR whose parent's `kind.type` isn't in this list. Editable as a free-text field in Type-builder, OR via a type-safe toggle picker in the cascade-palette //Manage kinds// drill (lists every kind except self, toggling commits to this field). |
|`kind.title-formula` |No |TW filter expression evaluated with `<target-tid>` as the source. Result becomes the new instance's title. Omit for manually-titled types. |
|`kind.auto-children` |No |JSON array. Each entry is `{"kind":"<child-type-key>","fields":{"<field>":"<value>",...}}`. When an instance of this type is saved (via any create path — in-tiddler //Creator// button, cascade-palette //+ New X//, ref-spawn from a `+ Create new …` row, or //Create here…//), each listed child instance is materialised with `parent` pre-set to the new parent's title + per-entry `fields` overrides + the child kind's normal field defaults applied. The child's `kind.title-formula` evaluates against the draft so it sees the back-ref. Entries referencing kinds that don't exist are skipped silently. NOT recursive — auto-children of auto-children don't fire automatically. Editable as raw JSON in Type-builder (3-row textarea), OR via a full CRUD drill in the cascade-palette //Manage kinds// drill — drill into ''auto-children (N)'', list of entries with a //+ Add auto-child entry…// picker, drill into an entry to edit per-field overrides (each as its own text-row, DEL removes the override) plus //+ Add field override…// picker filtered to fields not yet overridden, DEL on an entry-row removes the whole entry. No JSON typing required. |
|`kind.stream-fields` |No |Space-separated field keys shown in the stream-river field bar. Empty / missing = bar is invisible for instances of this type. |

!! Instance tiddler fields

|!Field |!Required |!Description |
|`kind.type` |Yes |The type key. Marks the tiddler as an instance. |
|Field keys from `kind.fields` |Per field's `constraints` |Each field's value is stored as a tiddler field with the name `<key>`. Multi-cardinality values are stored as space-separated lists (TW list-field convention). |

!! Field def schema (entries inside `kind.fields` JSON)

|!Property |!Required |!Description |!Applies to `typed` |
|`key` |Yes |Field key. Used as both the field name on instances and the identifier in `kind.stream-fields` / `kind.title-formula`. |all |
|`typed` |Yes |Editor kind. See //typed values// table. |all |
|`caption` |No |Display label. Falls back to `key` if absent. |all |
|`icon` |No |Emoji or short text. |all |
|`constraints` |No |Array of constraint strings. See //Constraints// table. |all (most relevant for editable types) |
|`options` |Required for `enum` |Array of option strings. |`enum` |
|`ref-types` |Optional for `ref` |Array of `kind.type` values whose instances may be referenced. When empty or absent, all kind-instances in the wiki are selectable (the type-builder displays //(any kind)//). |`ref` |
|`cardinality` |No (default `single`) |Either `single` or `multi`. Multi values are space-separated lists. |`enum`, `ref` |
|`formula` |Required for `$calculated` |Filter expression evaluated with `<target-tid>` as source. |`$calculated` |
|`default` |No |Filter expression evaluated against the draft (`<target-tid>`-as-source subfilter). Materialised onto each fresh instance for fields that would otherwise be blank, re-fired on ref/enum changes so dependent defaults populate after their dependencies are set. Examples: `[[planned]]` (static literal); `[<now "YYYY0MM0DD0hh0mm0ss0XXX">]` (current timestamp in TW canonical form — note single angle brackets in filter context, NOT `<<now …>>` which is wikitext-only); `[get[parent]get[caption]]` (reads parent's caption from the draft); `[get[parent]get[caption]] [[at]] [get[planned-at]format:date[0DD.0MM.YYYY 0hh:0mm]] +[join[ ]]` (composite — chain `+[join[X]]` for multi-item filters; otherwise only the first item is taken). User-typed values always win (the gate is `!has[<field>]`, not equality with the computed default). |text, longtext, number, date, datetime, url, email, phone, enum |
|`clone` |No |Set to `skip` to exclude this field from the ''+ Clone fields from existing'' copy in the cascade-palette creator (e.g. blank-out a journal `text` field on clone). Default = copy. Computed fields (`$title` / `$calculated`) are always excluded regardless. |all (most relevant on body / unique / computed-ish fields) |

!! `typed` values

|!Value |!Editor |!Notes |
|`text` |single-line input |Free-form short string |
|`longtext` |textarea |Free-form long text |
|`number` |numeric input |Stored as string; validate as needed |
|`date` |TW date picker |TW date format |
|`datetime` |TW date picker w/ time |TW datetime format, 24h |
|`url` |Single-line input (`type="url"`) |Format-checked: must start with `http://` or `https://` (when non-blank) |
|`email` |Single-line input (`type="email"`) |Format-checked: `local@domain.tld` shape (when non-blank) |
|`phone` |Single-line input (`type="tel"`) |Format-checked for German numbers (`+49` or `0` prefix, when non-blank) |
|`enum` |`<$select>` or pill toggle |`options` required; honour `cardinality` |
|`ref` |Typeahead (search + dropdown + selected pills) |`ref-types` optional (empty = any kind-instance); honour `cardinality`; display via target tiddler's caption (falls back to title) |
|`$title` |Read-only |Marks the field as the title position; not editable. Title is computed from the type's `kind.title-formula`. |
|`$calculated` |Read-only |Display-only derived field; value computed from the field's `formula` |

!! Constraints

|!String |!Meaning |
|`required` |Field value must not be blank |
|`min:N` |Minimum N characters (text/longtext) or N entries (multi enum/ref) |
|`max:N` |Maximum N characters or entries |
|`unique` |Field value must not equal another instance of the same type's same field |
|`unique:wiki` |Field value must not equal any other tiddler's same field |

All constraints are blocking — they show up in red in the validator and disable the Create button in the creator.

!! Config tiddlers

|!Path |!Purpose |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind/active-namespace` |Active namespace; empty = all |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind/streambar-max-length` |Truncation threshold for the stream-view field bar (default 20) |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind/instances-overview/edge-fields` |''Instances Overview'': ref-field keys drawn as edges (titlelist; ships defaulting to `parent`) |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind/instances-overview/hidden-types` |''Instances Overview'': type keys hidden from the graph (titlelist; empty/absent = all types shown) |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind/instances-overview/structure` |''Instances Overview'': persisted node positions — data tiddler whose index keys are instance titles and values are `x,y` |

!! State tiddlers

|!Path |!Purpose |
|`$:/state/rimir/kind/draft/<type-key>` |Creator's draft for in-progress instance |
|`$:/state/rimir/kind/instances-overview/search` |''Instances Overview'': node search-box text |
|`$:/state/rimir/kind/graph-modal` |Graph tooltip modal mode switch — `edit` field (live editor for that instance), `delete` field (confirm dialog), or `kind-tid` + `host` fields (create-child form). Deleted on Close/Cancel/Create/Delete |
|`$:/state/rimir/kind/graph-modal/draft` |Draft for the graph tooltip's ''Add child'' create form (parent pre-set, defaults applied; re-seeded on every tooltip button click) |
|`$:/state/rimir/kind/__graph-created` |Transient capture of the just-created tiddler title from the graph-modal create flow |
|`$:/state/rimir/kind/context/direction` |''Context'' preview: parent-tree direction — `to` (descendants, default) or `from` (ancestors) |

<$fill $name="body">

!! JSON-in-field via `jsonget` / `jsonindexes`

The whole field-array lives in `kind.fields` as a stringified JSON. Read it with:

```
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]]                       ← the JSON text
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonindexes[]]          ← top-level array indices "0","1",…
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonget<idx>,[key]]     ← scalar at path [idx].key
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonindexes<idx>,[constraints]]  ← inner-array indices for constraints
[<type-tid>get[kind.fields]jsonget<idx>,[constraints],<c-idx>]  ← one constraint string
```

The engine uses `multi-arg jsonget` (the form with comma-separated path arguments) consistently — chaining single-arg `jsonget` calls inside `:map` is a known TW gotcha that returns empty. See `[[tw-gotchas-filters#jsonget chained inside :map`]].

!! Discovery via `kind.type` + `kind.fields`

`[has[kind.type]has[kind.fields]]` finds tiddlers that look like type definitions — they need both fields. The `kind.fields` requirement filters out instance tiddlers (which have `kind.type` but no `kind.fields`).

`all[shadows+tiddlers]` is implicit in `engine.tid`'s `kind.types-all`; plugin-bundled types ARE shadows.

!! ViewTemplate auto-registration

`viewtemplate.tid` is tagged `$:/tags/ViewTemplate` with `list-after: $:/core/ui/ViewTemplate/title`. TiddlyWiki's ViewTemplate cascade renders all matching templates in order; ours runs right after the title, so the field bar appears at the very top of the body.

The `<%if [<currentTiddler>has[kind.type]] %>` guard means the template is silently a no-op for non-instance tiddlers.

!! Title-formula evaluation pattern

`kind.eval-title` mirrors the pattern from `rimir/typed`:

```
\function kind.eval-title(type-tid, target-tid)
  [<type-tid>get[kind.title-formula]]   ← gets the filter STRING
  :map[<target-tid>subfilter<currentTiddler>]   ← runs filter against target
```

The `<target-tid>subfilter<currentTiddler>` form makes `<target-tid>` the input source to the filter, and `<currentTiddler>` (the formula string from the outer map iteration) supplies the filter string to run.

''Formula authoring note'': each top-level run inside the formula starts with the subfilter source (the target instance). So write `[get[parent]]` (operates on source) NOT `[<currentTiddler>get[parent]]` (would override the source with the OUTER renderer's currentTiddler). The first form gets the target's parent; the second gets whatever tiddler is currently rendering the validator/creator UI — almost never what you want.

!! Live + bulk validation sharing predicates

Both `field-input.tid` (editor) and `validator.tid` (bulk) use the same `kind.viol-*` functions from `engine.tid`. The same constraint logic gives identical results in both surfaces, avoiding the typed-plugin trap where editor and validator drift apart over time.

The predicates are filter functions, so they participate in `:filter` / `<%if%>` predicates naturally and don't require JS.

!! Why no `rrfunc`

`rrfunc` exists in `rimir/typed` to defend against the inheritance slot pattern: `rrt.fields:1()` and `:2()` may legitimately not exist on a base type, and native `function[]` would leak input titles in that case. With flat schemas (no slot pattern), every function we call is guaranteed to be defined — native `function[]` is safe. `kind` ships zero JS modules in v0.1.0.

!! Restricted-wiki considerations

There are none. `kind` doesn't touch the `rimir/llm-connect` restricted-wiki sandbox; tools running in that sandbox can read instances via the standard `get` filter operator, but the kind editor/creator/validator UIs are not meant to render inside a restricted-wiki tool execution. If a future use case needs that, the editor would need to be self-contained (no `\import`) — see `[[tw-gotchas-plugin-quirks#`rimir/llm-connect` restricted wiki blocks `\import`]]`.

!! TW 5.4.0 compatibility

Variables avoid colon-named identifiers (which 5.4.0 parses as dynamic-arg macro calls — see `[[tw-gotchas-540-migration#`<<name:value>>` parses as macro dynamic arg]]`). Config tiddlers omit `type: text/plain` to avoid the filesystem-adapter's `.txt + .txt.meta` split (see `[[feedback-tid-vs-txt-meta]]`).

</$fill>
</$transclude>

\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine

<!-- 2-column editor for any typed instance.
     Required vars in scope:
       target-tid — tiddler to edit (may not exist yet)
     Optional:
       type-key   — fallback when the target tiddler doesn't yet carry kind.type
                    (creator passes this so the editor can render against an unborn draft)
-->

<$let
  type-key={{{ [<target-tid>get[kind.type]] ~[<type-key>] }}}
>
<%if [<type-key>is[blank]] %>
<div class="kind-err">target tiddler has no <code>kind.type</code> field</div>
<%else%>
<$let
  type-tid={{{ [function[kind.locate-type],<type-key>] }}}
>
<%if [<type-tid>is[blank]] %>
<div class="kind-err">no type definition found for kind.type="<<type-key>>"</div>
<%else%>
<table class="kind-editor">
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-keys],<type-tid>]" variable="field-key">
<%if [function[kind.is-computed-typed],<type-tid>,<field-key>!is[blank]] %>
<!-- skip $title and $calculated; they render in view, not editor -->
<%else%>
<tr>
<th class="kind-editor-label">
<$text text={{{ [function[kind.field-icon],<type-tid>,<field-key>] }}}/>
 <$text text={{{ [function[kind.field-caption],<type-tid>,<field-key>] }}}/>
</th>
<td class="kind-editor-value">
<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/kind/field-input"/>
</td>
</tr>
<%endif%>
</$list>
</table>
<%endif%>
</$let>
<%endif%>
</$let>

\procedure kind.apply-defaults-to(type-tid, target-tid)
<!-- Walks the type's fields. For each field, fires one $action-setfield whose
     $value is computed AT FIRE TIME via three-tier filter:
       1. existing non-blank value → keep (idempotent for user-typed values)
       2. else `kind.compute-default` (subfilter against draft) if non-blank
       3. else existing value (typically empty)
     The gate-inside-$value is critical for re-firing: when called from a
     ref/enum trailer in the same action chain that just set the dependency,
     the previous gating shape `<$list filter="…compute-default…!is[blank]">`
     evaluated at render time (before the dependency was set), so dependent
     fields' setfields were never rendered into the action tree at all.
     Putting the gate in `$value={{{…}}}` defers evaluation to fire time so
     each setfield sees the just-updated dependency state.
     `default` is always a subfilter evaluated against the draft, so
     `[[planned]]` writes the literal "planned", `[<now "YYYY0MM0DD0hh0mm0ss0XXX">]`
     writes the current timestamp, `[get[parent]get[caption]]` reads from the
     draft's parent. Also stamps `kind.type` so the draft is recognised by
     downstream consumers (e.g. the side-preview's instance-view template). -->
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> kind.type={{{ [<type-tid>get[kind.type]] }}}/>
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-keys],<type-tid>]" variable="field-key">
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-default],<type-tid>,<field-key>!is[blank]] +[first[]]" variable="_">
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $value={{{ [<target-tid>get<field-key>!is[blank]] ~[function[kind.compute-default],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>!is[blank]] ~[<target-tid>get<field-key>] +[first[]] }}}/>
</$list>
</$list>
\end

\procedure kind.finalize-create(kind-tid, kind-type-key, draft-tid, savetitle)
<!-- Shared "create the new instance" tail used by every save path (creator,
     cascade-save-instance, cascade-spawn-save, cascade-create-here). Computes
     the title via the kind's title-formula, creates the tiddler from the draft
     template, captures the post-uniquification title in <<savetitle>>, and
     runs apply-auto-children against that title. Callers pass their own
     savetitle so the captured title remains visible to flow-specific follow-ups
     (e.g. mass-create's $action-navigate). Idempotent in the sense that the
     auto-children step is a no-op for kinds without kind.auto-children. -->
<$action-createtiddler $basetitle={{{ [function[kind.eval-title],<kind-tid>,<draft-tid>] }}} $template=<<draft-tid>> $savetitle=<<savetitle>> kind.type=<<kind-type-key>>/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.apply-auto-children" parent-tid={{{ [<savetitle>get[text]] }}} type-tid=<<kind-tid>>/>
\end

\procedure kind.apply-auto-children(parent-tid, type-tid)
<!-- Walks the parent type's `kind.auto-children` JSON array and creates each
     listed child instance with `parent: <<parent-tid>>` + per-entry field
     overrides + the child kind's own field defaults applied. The child's
     `kind.title-formula` evaluates against the draft (so it sees the pre-set
     parent + overrides). Called by every "save parent instance" path after
     the parent tiddler exists. Entries pointing at non-existent kinds are
     skipped silently. NOT recursive — auto-children of auto-children don't
     fire (the child create here uses $action-createtiddler directly, not a
     save-path that calls this procedure). Keeps shared state simple. -->
<$list filter="[function[kind.auto-children-indexes],<type-tid>]" variable="ac-idx">
<$let child-kind-key={{{ [function[kind.auto-child-kind-at],<type-tid>,<ac-idx>] }}}>
<$let
  child-type-tid={{{ [function[kind.locate-type],<child-kind-key>] }}}
  child-draft={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/__auto-child-draft/]] +[addsuffix<parent-tid>] +[addsuffix[/]] +[addsuffix<ac-idx>] }}}
>
<$list filter="[<child-type-tid>!is[blank]]">
<$transclude $variable="kind.apply-defaults-to" type-tid=<<child-type-tid>> target-tid=<<child-draft>>/>
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<child-draft>> parent=<<parent-tid>>/>
<$list filter="[function[kind.auto-child-fields-at],<type-tid>,<ac-idx>]" variable="fk">
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<child-draft>> $field=<<fk>> $value={{{ [function[kind.auto-child-field-value-at],<type-tid>,<ac-idx>,<fk>] }}}/>
</$list>
<$action-createtiddler $basetitle={{{ [function[kind.eval-title],<child-type-tid>,<child-draft>] }}} $template=<<child-draft>> kind.type=<<child-kind-key>>/>
<$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<child-draft>>/>
</$list>
</$let>
</$let>
</$list>
\end

\procedure kind.force-apply-defaults(type-tid, target-tid)
<!-- Like kind.apply-defaults-to but unconditional: writes every defaulted
     field regardless of existing state, falling back to existing value if
     the formula returns blank. Used by the Reset row. Same fire-time
     evaluation pattern via $value={{{…}}} so a Reset clicked after partial
     dependency fills resolves the cascade correctly. Stamps `kind.type` so
     the freshly-reset draft is recognised by the side-preview. -->
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> kind.type={{{ [<type-tid>get[kind.type]] }}}/>
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-keys],<type-tid>]" variable="field-key">
<$list filter="[function[kind.field-default],<type-tid>,<field-key>!is[blank]] +[first[]]" variable="_">
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $value={{{ [function[kind.compute-default],<type-tid>,<field-key>,<target-tid>!is[blank]] ~[<target-tid>get<field-key>] +[first[]] }}}/>
</$list>
</$list>
\end

<!-- Per-field input dispatcher.
     Required vars in scope (via $let from caller):
       type-tid     — type definition tiddler
       type-key     — type's kind.type value
       target-tid   — instance tiddler being edited
       field-key    — the field being edited
     Optional:
       inline       — if "yes", suppress validation messages (popup mode shows them; inline mode is terse)
-->

<$let
  field-typed={{{[function[kind.field-typed],<type-tid>,<field-key>]}}}
  field-card={{{[function[kind.field-cardinality],<type-tid>,<field-key>]}}}
>

<%if [<field-typed>match[$title]] [<field-typed>match[$calculated]] +[first[]] %>
<!-- read-only computed; rendered elsewhere -->

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[longtext]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> tag="textarea" class="kind-input kind-textarea"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[number]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="number" tag="input" class="kind-input"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[date]] %>
<$edit-date tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>>/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[datetime]] %>
<$edit-date tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> showTime="yes" use24hour="yes"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[url]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="url" tag="input" class="kind-input" placeholder="https://…"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[email]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="email" tag="input" class="kind-input" placeholder="name@example.com"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[phone]] %>
<$edit-text tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> type="tel" tag="input" class="kind-input" placeholder="+49 30 12345678"/>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[enum]] %>
<%if [<field-card>match[multi]] %>
<div class="kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[function[kind.options],<type-tid>,<field-key>]" variable="opt">
<$let active={{{[<target-tid>get<field-key>enlist-input[]match<opt>limit[1]]}}}>
<$button class={{{[<active>!is[blank]then[kind-pill kind-pill-on]] ~[kind-pill]}}}>
<$action-listops $tiddler=<<target-tid>> $field=<<field-key>> $subfilter="+[toggle<opt>]"/>
<$transclude $variable="kind.apply-defaults-to" type-tid=<<type-tid>> target-tid=<<target-tid>>/>
<<opt>>
</$button>
</$let>
</$list>
</div>
<%else%>
<$select tiddler=<<target-tid>> field=<<field-key>> class="kind-input" actions="<$transclude $variable='kind.apply-defaults-to' type-tid=<<type-tid>> target-tid=<<target-tid>>/>">
<option value=""></option>
<$list filter="[function[kind.options],<type-tid>,<field-key>]" variable="opt">
<option value=<<opt>>><<opt>></option>
</$list>
</$select>
<%endif%>

<%elseif [<field-typed>match[ref]] %>
<$let
  search-state={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/ta/]addsuffix<target-tid>addsuffix[/]addsuffix<field-key>] }}}
  is-multi={{{ [<field-card>match[multi]] }}}
  cur={{{ [<target-tid>get<field-key>] }}}
>
<%if [<is-multi>!is[blank]] %>

×

×

! 🕸️ Kind: Instances Overview

A graph of every [[kind|$:/plugins/rimir/kind]] instance in the wiki. Nodes start on a stable grid; **drag a node to reposition it — that position is saved** (to `$:/config/rimir/kind/instances-overview/structure`) and restored on reload. Double-click a node to open it, hover for a tooltip — the tooltip offers ''edit'' (live field editor), ''delete'' (with confirmation; disabled while the node still has children) and ''Add child'' buttons for every kind whose `parent` field accepts this node's type, opening a create form with the parent pre-filled. Tick edge fields to draw those relationships; untick a type to hide its instances.

<style>
.kg-controls { display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:6px; }
.kg-controls label { white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; }

>

</$list>
</div>

<$list filter="[function[kg.type-keys]]" variable="_tk">
<$let
  _c={{{ [function[kg.color-of],<_tk>] }}}

>
<$button class="kg-legend" style={{{ [<_c>addprefix[color:]] }}}>

<%if [[$:/plugins/flibbles/graph]is[tiddler]] %>

\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine
\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/graph

<!-- Side-preview: the local neighbourhood of the active kind-instance,
     drawn with the SAME node layout / persisted positions as
     "Kind: Instances Overview" (shared kg-graph + the shared structure
     data tiddler), but scoped to N levels of the parent-tree around
     <<currentTiddler>>. Direction & depth are picked with pills:
       from = ancestors (walk `parent` upward)
       to   = descendants (children, grandchildren, …)  [default]
     The kin operator's depth lives in a static suffix, so the filter
     string is assembled with $(...)$ substitution (kg.ctx-filter) with
     the concrete direction / depth / base baked in. Requires a graph
     engine (flibbles/graph + adapter) and the bimlas kin-filter plugin. -->

\define kg.ctx-filter() [kin:parent:$(kgDir)$:$(kgDepth)$[$(kgBase)$]] :filter[is[tiddler]has[kind.type]!has[kind.fields]] :filter[function[kg.type-shown],<currentTiddler>,<hiddenTypes>]

\procedure ctx-dir-pill(value, label)
<$button class={{{ [<kgDir>match<value>then[kind-pill kind-pill-on]] ~[[kind-pill]] }}}>
<$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/state/rimir/kind/context/direction" text=<<value>>/>
<$text text=<<label>>/>
</$button>
\end

\procedure ctx-depth-pill(value)
<$button class={{{ [<kgDepth>match<value>then[kind-pill kind-pill-on]] ~[[kind-pill]] }}}>
<$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/state/rimir/kind/context/depth" text=<<value>>/>
<$text text=<<value>>/>
</$button>
\end

\procedure ctx-edge-pill(value)
<$let
  _cur={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/context/edge-fields]get[fields]] ~[[parent]] }}}
  _on={{{ [enlist<_cur>match<value>count[]] }}}
  _without={{{ [enlist<_cur>] -[<value>] +[join[ ]] }}}
  _with={{{ [enlist<_cur>] [<value>] +[unique[]join[ ]] }}}
  _ec={{{ [function[kg.edge-color],<value>] }}}
>
<$button class={{{ [<_on>compare:integer:gt[0]then[kind-pill kind-cpill kind-cpill-on]] ~[[kind-pill kind-cpill kind-cpill-off]] }}} style={{{ [<_ec>addprefix[--kp:]] }}}>
<$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/state/rimir/kind/context/edge-fields" $field="fields" $value={{{ [<_on>compare:integer:gt[0]then<_without>] ~[<_with>] }}}/>
<span class="kind-pill-dot"></span><$text text=<<value>>/>
</$button>
</$let>
\end

\procedure ctx-type-pill(value)
<$let
  _c={{{ [function[kg.color-of],<value>] }}}
  _hidden={{{ [enlist<hiddenTypes>match<value>count[]] }}}
  _without={{{ [enlist<hiddenTypes>] -[<value>] +[join[ ]] }}}
  _with={{{ [enlist<hiddenTypes>] [<value>] +[unique[]join[ ]] }}}
>
<$button class={{{ [<_hidden>compare:integer:gt[0]then[kind-pill kind-cpill kind-cpill-off]] ~[[kind-pill kind-cpill kind-cpill-on]] }}} style={{{ [<_c>addprefix[--kp:]] }}}>
<$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/state/rimir/kind/context/hidden-types" $field="hidden" $value={{{ [<_hidden>compare:integer:gt[0]then<_without>] ~[<_with>] }}}/>
<span class="kind-pill-dot"></span><$text text=<<value>>/>
</$button>
</$let>
\end

<$let
  kgBase=<<currentTiddler>>
  kgDir={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/context/direction]get[text]] ~[[to]] }}}
  kgDepth={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/context/depth]get[text]] ~[[2]] }}}
  hiddenTypes={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/context/hidden-types]get[hidden]] }}}
  selFields={{{ [[$:/state/rimir/kind/context/edge-fields]get[fields]] ~[[parent]] }}}
>

<%if [<kgBase>get[kind.type]is[blank]] %>
<div class="kind-view-empty">Not a kind-instance — no <code>kind.type</code> on <code><$text text=<<kgBase>>/></code>.</div>
<%else%>

<div class="kind-ctx-fill">

<div class="kind-ctx-controls">
<span class="kind-ctx-label">Direction:</span>
<span class="kind-ctx-group kind-pill-row">
<<ctx-dir-pill to "↓ Descendants">>
<<ctx-dir-pill from "↑ Ancestors">>
</span>
<span class="kind-ctx-label">Levels:</span>
<span class="kind-ctx-group kind-pill-row">
<<ctx-depth-pill 1>>
<<ctx-depth-pill 2>>
<<ctx-depth-pill 3>>
<<ctx-depth-pill 4>>
<<ctx-depth-pill 5>>
</span>
<span class="kind-ctx-label">Edges:</span>
<span class="kind-ctx-group kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[function[kg.ref-fields]]" variable="_rf">
<$transclude $variable="ctx-edge-pill" value=<<_rf>>/>
</$list>
</span>
</div>

<div class="kind-ctx-controls">
<span class="kind-ctx-label">Types:</span>
<span class="kind-ctx-group kind-pill-row">
<$list filter="[function[kg.type-keys]]" variable="_tk">
<$transclude $variable="ctx-type-pill" value=<<_tk>>/>
</$list>
</span>
</div>

<%if [[$:/plugins/flibbles/graph]is[tiddler]] %>
<div class="boundingbox kind-ctx-graph">
<$transclude $variable="kg-graph"
  nodeFilter=<<kg.ctx-filter>>
  selFields=<<selFields>>
  dataTiddler="$:/config/rimir/kind/instances-overview/structure"
  physics="no"
  $mode="block"/>
</div>
<%else%>
<div class="kind-warn">Needs a graph engine — install <code>flibbles/graph</code> plus a render adapter (e.g. <code>flibbles/vis-network</code>) to see the context graph.</div>
<%endif%>

</div>
<%endif%>

</$let>
